title: TransferArtifact
description: Immutable archived input or output bytes and classified handling evidence.

id.description: Immutable identity allocated once by the interoperability owner.

institution_id.description: Institution owning these data and their access policy.
institution_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

uploader_principal_id.description: Authorized actor or service identity for the recorded operation.
uploader_principal_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

source_namespace.description: Pre-registered import provenance or outbound destination namespace.

original_filename.description: Sanitized basename for operator display only.

byte_length.description: Actual length counted during stream verification.

sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 hexadecimal digest of the exact named bytes.

storage_object_id.description: Platform-owned private bytes with owner resource, object version, scan status, digest and retention hold.
storage_object_id.x-reference-scope: The StorageObject belongs to this Institution and exact TransferArtifact generation, with package, evidence or export purpose.

storage_scope.description: Institution-local storage trust and retention partition.

detected_format.description: Detected input shape independently of installation support.

detected_container.description: Outer verified container independently of the source format and profile.

signature_evidence.description: Safe evidence for matching manifest signature and version.

scan_engine.description: Scanner and signature version for the latest observation.

state.description: Authoritative lifecycle state advanced only through owner commands.

retain_until.description: Minimum planned availability deadline before hold checks.

x-invariants: The verified digest is immutable after quarantine.
Raw archive reads need explicit artifact authority and permission to every included data class.
Detect and retain profile evidence before import approval.

Release eligibility requires an accepted StorageObject version with matching hash and exact byte length. Quarantine may read it only through the storage owner. Storage deduplication never shares domain authorization.
A verified blob may be physically deduplicated within approved storage custody. Separate source namespaces or protected artifact authorities still require distinct TransferArtifact identity.
